FygoOSStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: FygoOS host detected. Storage pools, external drives, and media directories are authoritatively managed by FygoOS. Telemetry and capacity auditing enabled.

GenericLinuxStorageAdapter.description: Active Provisioner Mode: Bare-metal Linux host detected. Full pool, subvolume snapshot, and share lifecycle management enabled.

GenericObserverStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: Non-intrusive telemetry mode active. Storage pools and file shares are authoritatively managed by host OS. Block-level modifications are strictly disabled.

ProxmoxStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: Proxmox VE host detected. Storage pools and LVM/ZFS thin-pools are managed by PVE storage engine. Telemetry and scrub monitoring enabled.

TrueNASStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: TrueNAS SCALE host detected. ZFS pools, datasets, and shares are managed by TrueNAS Middleware. Telemetry and scrub monitoring enabled.

UgosStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: UGOS (UGREEN NAS OS) host detected. Storage pools, mdadm RAID groups, and LVM volumes are authoritatively managed by UGOS. Telemetry and RAID scrub monitoring enabled.

UnraidStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: Unraid OS authoritatively manages array disks and shares. Modifying pools from container is prohibited to protect parity.

ZettOSStorageAdapter.description: Observer Mode: ZettOS appliance host detected. Hybrid ZFS/Btrfs storage pools, parity groups, and shares are authoritatively managed by ZettOS. Telemetry and scrub monitoring enabled.
